notes: Value is Bullpen WAR; the rate is per 600 plate appearances (hitters) or 700 batters faced (pitchers).
Best at each position: players whose primary position it is (most games there; pitchers by role), with at least half the leaderboard floor.
Next season: a Marcel-style projection of the WAR rate (three seasons, regressed, aged) times Marcel's playing time.

Next season (e1) and three seasons (e3): expected WAR from the projection aged season by season and calibrated on history (attrition, injuries and regression included); lo/hi: the 10th and 90th percentiles of what players with that expectation went on to produce.

Value (v5): five seasons, discounted 8% a year; WAR is above replacement, so this is the surplus over a freely available player. Salaries are not known (no legitimate free source), so it is not net of pay.
Injured list (il3): days in each of the last three seasons from the MLB Stats API transactions; il_exp and il_p30: next season's expected days and the chance of 30 or more.
pos_line: the projected full-season value of the median starter (15th best) at the player's position; over_line: his projected value there minus that line.
